'''Korraks''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of large, [[Snake/Legends|serpent]]-like [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. They possessed eight short and stubby but powerful [[Limb/Legends|legs]], ending in clawed feet and allowing them to move incredibly quickly both and lands and when climbing [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. Covered in pebbly scales, a korrak's body was long and sinuous and allowed them to be relatively agile. To attack the creatures either attempted to wrap themselves around a target and crush it or used the deadly [[Neurotoxin/Legends|neurotoxin]] in their bite. They would sometimes attack sentients.<ref name="SoF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Korraks were first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.
